rule: Width of every card manage_diagram creates on a capability map; it cannot be changed there
Height of a card with no footer and fewer than two list lines
A card with no footer is list_base plus list_line_height per list line tall (at least card_height)
A card with a footer is footer_height plus list_line_height per list line tall
Height a card gains per list line (card attribute)
Width of a text box (a heading) as manage_diagram creates it whatever its text; the text is centred in it and wraps
Height of a text box; its text is centred in it and is cut after about four lines
Horizontal space between neighbouring columns of cards
Columns on one row of the grid before the rest wrap to a new row; a capability continuing into a second column counts each
Sub-capabilities stacked under one heading before the rest continue in the next column
Vertical space between cards stacked under one heading
Vertical space before a sub-heading; the text box adds about 25 px of its own above the text so the visible gap is about 40 px and groups read apart
Vertical space between the drivers row and the grid; between rows of the grid; and between band rows
Space between a heading's text box and the first card under it; the text is centred in its 80 px box so the visible gap under two lines of heading is about 30 px
Horizontal space between the legend column and the grid
Longest word a heading can hold; the text box is 120 px wide and does not break words (about 104 px of text)
Longest word a heading can hold in capitals; a top-level heading with a longer word keeps its own case
Top-level capability headings and section headings (drivers and legend) in capitals so they read above sub-headings; a text box cannot be bold or larger
Border of a top-level capability or band drawn as a card (one whose sub-capabilities are list lines or that has none)
Fill of such a card when it has no rating
Border of a rated card below the top level; fill comes from data/capability-ratings.csv
Text of the heading over the driver cards
Longest card title before the plan warns it will crowd the card (the card does not grow for its title)
Longest heading before the plan warns its text box will cut it
Longest footer before the plan warns (the card does not grow for its footer)
Most list lines on one card before the plan warns the card is getting long
